messages:
Alex Chen: Quick pre-oncall check for tonight (handing off at 20:00 PT). Can folks confirm VPN, pager access, and runbook visibility? I also pushed a tiny change to the runbook earlier.
Priya Patel: I can take 20:00 handoff. Runbook URL: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/night-handoff (I updated the 'test page' section).
Jamal Rivera: VPN creds are fine for me. Note: I rotated the bastion cert this morning; if you hit a cert error, `ssh -vvv -J bastion:2200` should show the new fingerprint.
Sophia Li: Confirmed pager access for me, escalation policy -> oncall-sre-primary. I ran the test page to infra and got a 200 ack. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: @priya can you add a one-line note about the new bastion fingerprint (thumbprint ends with b3:4f) so people don't churn?
Priya Patel: Done. Added a short note and a CLI snippet under Troubleshooting.
Priya Patel: Snippet I added:
```
# verify fingerprint
ssh-keygen -l -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub | grep b3:4f
```
Jamal Rivera: Also left a short note about the VPN client version mismatch we saw last week. If anyone still on v1.12, please update to v1.14 before the handoff.
infra-bot: Test page event: pager test sent to oncall-sre-primary at 2005001300, response received by Sophia Li at 2005001304.
Sophia Li: I validated SSH -> bastion -> prod-db access at 2005001320. No prompt for additional MFA.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Checklist for handoff: (1) confirm runbook visible (done), (2) pager test success (done), (3) VPN + SSH validated (done), (4) add bastion fingerprint note (done). If no objections I'll close this and DM the next oncall at 19:45.
Priya Patel: no objections, thanks everyone.
Jamal Rivera: all good from infra side, enjoy the shift :coffee:
